name: Patient Clinical Model 1.0
description: This is the release candidate version of the PIQI Clinical model reviewed by the PIQI Alliance Patient Clinical Data Class Model work group - as of 4/15/2026

attributes.name: Demographics data class
attributes.description: A collection of demographic attributes for the patient.

attributes.name: Demographics element
attributes.description: A single Demographic element of the Demographics Data Class.

attributes.name: birthDate
attributes.description: The patient's date of birth.

attributes.name: deceased
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is deceased.

attributes.name: birthSex
attributes.description: The patient's sex assigned at birth *Note: When converting from FHIR, this comes from the gender property.

attributes.name: genderIdentity
attributes.description: The patient's gender identity.

attributes.name: race
attributes.description: The patient's race.

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: The patient's ethnicity.

attributes.name: maritalStatus
attributes.description: The patient's marital status.

attributes.name: primaryLanguage
attributes.description: The patients primary language

attributes.name: deathDate
attributes.description: The date of death of the patient.

attributes.name: patientIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the patient.

attributes.name: tribalAffiliation
attributes.description: The patient's affiliation with a recognized American Indian or Alaska Native tribe.

attributes.name: sexualOrientation
attributes.description: The patient's self-reported sexual orientation.

attributes.name: firstName
attributes.description: The patient's first (given) name.

attributes.name: lastName
attributes.description: The patient's last (family) name.

attributes.name: middleName
attributes.description: The patient's middle name or initial.

attributes.name: currentAddress
attributes.description: The patient's current mailing or home address.

attributes.name: emailAddress
attributes.description: The patient's email address.

attributes.name: telecom
attributes.description: The patient's telephone or other telecommunication contact information.

attributes.name: Allergies data class
attributes.description: A collection representing a patient's allergies and substance intolerances.

attributes.name: Allergies element
attributes.description: A single Allergy element of the Allergy Data Class.

attributes.name: substance
attributes.description: The specific substance or allergen responsible for the reaction.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The category of the allergy (e.g., medication, food, environment).

attributes.name: reaction
attributes.description: The clinical manifestation (reaction) resulting from exposure to the allergen.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: The clinical assessment of the severity of the reaction.

attributes.name: effectiveDate
attributes.description: The date when the allergy or substance intolerance was first recorded.

attributes.name: clinicalStatus
attributes.description: The clinical status of the allergy or intolerance (e.g., active, inactive, resolved).

attributes.name: verificationStatus
attributes.description: The assertion of the certainty that the propensity to a reaction to the identified substance is present (e.g., confirmed, unconfirmed, refuted).

attributes.name: Conditions data class
attributes.description: A collection representing a patient's problems, diagnoses, and conditions.

attributes.name: Conditions element
attributes.description: A single Condition element of the Conditions Data Class.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: A clinical condition, problem, or diagnosis.

attributes.name: onsetDate
attributes.description: The date when the condition started.

attributes.name: conditionStatus
attributes.description: The clinical status of the condition.

attributes.name: resolutionDate
attributes.description: The date when the condition resolved.

attributes.name: clinicalStatus
attributes.description: The clinical status of the condition (e.g., active, recurrence, relapse, inactive, remission, resolved).

attributes.name: verificationStatus
attributes.description: The verification status of the condition, indicating the certainty of the diagnosis (e.g., confirmed, unconfirmed, provisional, refuted).

attributes.name: conditionCategory
attributes.description: The category assigned to the condition (e.g., problem-list-item, encounter-diagnosis, health-concern).

attributes.name: assertedDate
attributes.description: The date the condition was first asserted or claimed by the patient or a clinician.

attributes.name: recordedDate
attributes.description: The date the condition was first recorded in the patient's clinical record.

attributes.name: Immunizations data class
attributes.description: A collection of Immunization s for the patient.

attributes.name: Immunizations element
attributes.description: A single Immunization element of the Immunizations Data Class.

attributes.name: administrationDate
attributes.description: The date the immunization was administered.

attributes.name: immunization
attributes.description: The vaccine or immunization administered.

attributes.name: lotNumber
attributes.description: The lot number of the immunization product.

attributes.name: reaction
attributes.description: The reaction to the immunization.

attributes.name: expirationDate
attributes.description: The expiration date of the immunization product.

attributes.name: immunizationStatus
attributes.description: The immunization status for the immunization.  May include that the immunization was refused.

attributes.name: immunizationStatusReason
attributes.description: Reason not done

attributes.name: primarySource
attributes.description: Indicates context the data was recorded in

attributes.name: Lab Results data class
attributes.description: A collection of laboratory result observations.

attributes.name: Lab Results element
attributes.description: A single Lab Result element of the Lab Results Data Class.

attributes.name: orderedTest
attributes.description: The order or panel that initiated the test.

attributes.name: performedTest
attributes.description: The specific laboratory test performed.

attributes.name: resultUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the laboratory result value.

attributes.name: resultValue
attributes.description: The value of the laboratory result.

attributes.name: interpretation
attributes.description: The interpretation of the laboratory result.

attributes.name: specimenType
attributes.description: The type of specimen used for the test.

attributes.name: resultStatus
attributes.description: The status of the laboratory result.

attributes.name: performedDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the test was performed.

attributes.name: issuedDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the lab test result was issued

attributes.name: referenceRange
attributes.description: The reference range for the laboratory test result.

attributes.name: performingSite
attributes.description: The site where the laboratory test was performed.

attributes.name: specimenidentifier
attributes.description: The identifier for the specimen used to perform the laboratory test.

attributes.name: specimenSourceSite
attributes.description: The concept used to represent the site for the specimen used to perform the test.

attributes.name: specimenCondition
attributes.description: The concept representing the condition of the specimen used to perform the laboratory test.

attributes.name: specimenCollectionDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the specimen for the laboratory test was collected.

attributes.name: orderDate
attributes.description: The date the laboratory order was placed.

attributes.name: labCategory
attributes.description: Classification of type of observation

attributes.name: performerName
attributes.description: The name of the laboratory or organization that performed the test.

attributes.name: performerIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the laboratory or organization that performed the test.

attributes.name: Medications data class
attributes.description: A collection of medications

attributes.name: Medications element
attributes.description: A single Medication element of the Medications Data Class.

attributes.name: medication
attributes.description: The medication product

attributes.name: doseAmount
attributes.description: The amount of medication per dose.

attributes.name: doseAmountUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the dose amount.

attributes.name: doseRoute
attributes.description: The route of administration for the medication.

attributes.name: doseQuantity
attributes.description: The quantity of medication dispensed.

attributes.name: doseQuantityUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the dose quantity.

attributes.name: instructions
attributes.description: The instructions for taking the medication

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The indication or reason for the medication.

attributes.name: startDate
attributes.description: The date the patient started the medication.

attributes.name: endDate
attributes.description: The date the patient stopped taking the medication.

attributes.name: statementDate
attributes.description: The date of the medication statement.

attributes.name: adherence
attributes.description: The patient's adherence to the medication regimen.

attributes.name: fillStatus
attributes.description: The fill status of the medication.

attributes.name: requestStatus
attributes.description: The current status of the medication request, such as active, stopped, or completed.

attributes.name: medicationCategory
attributes.description: Classification of the medication context, such as community or inpatient.

attributes.name: medicationIntent
attributes.description: The intended purpose of the medication record, such as order, plan, or proposal.

attributes.name: Procedures data class
attributes.description: A collection of procedures for the patient.

attributes.name: Procedures element
attributes.description: A single Procedure element of the Procedures Data Class.

attributes.name: procedureDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the procedure was performed.

attributes.name: procedure
attributes.description: The procedure performed on the patient.

attributes.name: procedureReason
attributes.description: The reason for the procedure.

attributes.name: procedure status
attributes.description: The concept representing the procedure status.

attributes.name: procedure performed date
attributes.description: The date and time the procedure was performed.

attributes.name: procedure start datetime
attributes.description: The date and time the procedure was started

attributes.name: procedure end datetime
attributes.description: the date and time the procedure was completed

attributes.name: Vital Signs data class
attributes.description: A collection of vital sign observations.

attributes.name: Vital Signs element
attributes.description: A single Vital Sign element of the Vital Signs Data Class.

attributes.name: vitalSign
attributes.description: A specific vital sign assessment or test.

attributes.name: resultValue
attributes.description: The value of the vital sign result.

attributes.name: resultUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the vital sign result.

attributes.name: interpretation
attributes.description: The interpretation of the vital sign.

attributes.name: resultStatus
attributes.description: The status of the vital sign result.

attributes.name: performedDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the vital sign was measured.

attributes.name: performingSite
attributes.description: The site where the vital sign was measured.

attributes.name: referenceRange
attributes.description: The reference range for the vital sign.

attributes.name: issuedDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the vital sign was issued.

attributes.name: vitalSignCategory
attributes.description: Classification of the vital sign type.

attributes.name: dataAbsentReason
attributes.description: The reason a vital sign result value is absent or not available.

attributes.name: Diagnostic Imaging data class
attributes.description: Patient diagnostic imaging results.

attributes.name: Diagnostic Imaging element
attributes.description: A single Diagnostic Imaging element of the Diagnostic Imaging Data Class.

attributes.name: interpretation
attributes.description: The interpretation of the diagnostic images.

attributes.name: reportDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the diagnostic imaging was performed.

attributes.name: procedure
attributes.description: the concept representing the diagnostic imaging procedure.

attributes.name: hasAttachment
attributes.description: An indicator representing whether or not a digital attachment was present in the original diagnostic imaging resource. (Interpreted and populated by the PIQI converter)

attributes.name: issueDate
attributes.description: The date and time the diagnostic imaging report was issued.

attributes.name: reportStatus
attributes.description: The current status of the imaging report, such as final, preliminary, or amended.

attributes.name: reportCategory
attributes.description: Classification of the type of diagnostic imaging report.

attributes.name: reportPeriodStart
attributes.description: The start date of the period covered by the imaging report.

attributes.name: reportPeriodEnd
attributes.description: The end date of the period covered by the imaging report.

attributes.name: reportResultValue
attributes.description: The quantitative or qualitative result value from the imaging report.

attributes.name: reportResultUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for any quantitative imaging result value.

attributes.name: dataAbsentReason
attributes.description: The reason an imaging result value is absent or not available.

attributes.name: performerName
attributes.description: The name of the clinician or organization that performed the imaging study.

attributes.name: performerIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the clinician or organization that performed the imaging study.

dataClasses.name: Medical Devices
dataClasses.description: Patient implanted and prosthetic medical devices.

attributes.name: Medical Devices data class
attributes.description: A collection of devices for the patient.

attributes.name: Medical Devices element
attributes.description: A single Medical Device element of the Medical Devices Data Class.

attributes.name: deviceID
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the medical device.

attributes.name: deviceType
attributes.description: The type of medical device.

attributes.name: implantationDate
attributes.description: The date the device was implanted.

attributes.name: deviceStatus
attributes.description: The status of the medical device.

attributes.name: serialNumber
attributes.description: The serial number assigned by the manufacturer to identify the specific medical device.

attributes.name: lotNumber
attributes.description: The lot or batch number assigned by the manufacturer to the medical device.

attributes.name: expirationDate
attributes.description: The expiration date of the medical device as indicated on the device label.

attributes.name: manufactureDate
attributes.description: The date the medical device was manufactured.

attributes.name: carrierHRF
attributes.description: The human-readable form of the carrier or distributor identifier for the medical device.

attributes.name: distinctIdentifier
attributes.description: A distinct identification code required by regulation for a human cell, tissue, or cellular and tissue-based product.

attributes.name: Health Assessments data class
attributes.description: A collection of health assessment observations.

attributes.name: Health Assessments element
attributes.description: A single Health Assessment element of the Health Assessments Data Class.

attributes.name: assessment
attributes.description: A specific health assessment observation.

attributes.name: assessmentStatus
attributes.description: The current status of the health assessment, such as final, preliminary, or amended.

attributes.name: resultValue
attributes.description: The value of the health assessment result .

attributes.name: resultUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the health assessment result.

attributes.name: effectiveDate
attributes.description: The date and time the health assessment was performed.

attributes.name: IssueDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the health assessment result was issued.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The category of the health assessment observation (e.g., functional status, disability status, SDOH).

attributes.name: questionnaireURL
attributes.description: The URL or identifier of the questionnaire or survey instrument used for the assessment.

attributes.name: performerName
attributes.description: The name of the clinician or organization that performed the health assessment.

attributes.name: performerIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the clinician or organization that performed the health assessment.

attributes.name: Clinical Documents data class
attributes.description: Patient clinical documents,

attributes.name: Clinical Documents element
attributes.description: A single Document element of the Documents Data Class.

attributes.name: documentType
attributes.description: The concept representing the type of clinical document.

attributes.name: documentTitle
attributes.description: The document title the the clinical document.

attributes.name: effectiveDate
attributes.description: The effective date and time of the document.

attributes.name: documentStatus
attributes.description: The concept representing the status of the clinical document.

attributes.name: hasAttachment
attributes.description: The indicator representing whether or not the original clinical document resource included a digital attachment.  (Interpreted and populated by the PIQI converter)

attributes.name: documentIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the clinical document.

attributes.name: documentCategory
attributes.description: The category of the clinical document (e.g., clinical note, discharge summary, progress note).

attributes.name: documentAuthorName
attributes.description: The name of the author who created or is responsible for the clinical document.

attributes.name: documentAuthorIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the author who created or is responsible for the clinical document.

attributes.name: documentPeriodStart
attributes.description: The start date of the period that the clinical document content covers or pertains to.

attributes.name: documentPeriodEnd
attributes.description: The end date of the period that the clinical document content covers or pertains to.

attributes.name: documentFormat
attributes.description: The technical format or encoding of the clinical document (e.g., PDF, CDA, FHIR).

attributes.name: Encounters data class
attributes.description: Patient healthcare encounters.

attributes.name: Encounters element
attributes.description: A single Encounter element of the Encounters Data Class.

attributes.name: encounterIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the encounter.

attributes.name: encounterIdentifierNamespace
attributes.description: The namespace or system that assigned the encounter identifier, used to ensure uniqueness across systems.

attributes.name: encounterDiagnosis
attributes.description: The concept representing the encounter diagnosis or chief complaint.

attributes.name: encounterDisposition
attributes.description: The encounter representing the encounter disposition.

attributes.name: encounterDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time of the start of the encounter

attributes.name: encounterStartDate
attributes.description: The date and time the encounter began.

attributes.name: encounterEndDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the encounter concluded.

attributes.name: encounterLocation
attributes.description: The encounter location.

attributes.name: encounterType
attributes.description: The concept representing the category of health care service. (e.g., office visit, telephone assessment, home visit)

attributes.name: encounterReason
attributes.description: The concept representing the reason for the encounter.

attributes.name: encounterStatus
attributes.description: The concept representing the status of the encounter.

attributes.name: encounterClass
attributes.description: The classification of the encounter setting (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, emergency, home health).

attributes.name: Goals data class
attributes.description: Patient healthcare related goals.

attributes.name: Goals element
attributes.description: A single Encounter element of the Encounters Data Class.

attributes.name: goalCategory
attributes.description: The concept representing the category of the goal.

attributes.name: goalPriority
attributes.description: The priority of the goal.

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description: The concept representing the patient goal.  (SDOH goals, Treatable Prevention Preferences, Care Experience Preferences, etc.)

attributes.name: goalStatus
attributes.description: The concept representing the status of the goal.

attributes.name: startDate
attributes.description: The date and time the patient goal was initiated.

attributes.name: effectiveDate
attributes.description: The date and time of the documentation of the goal.

attributes.name: dueDate
attributes.description: The target date by which the patient goal is intended to be achieved.

attributes.name: Care Plans data class
attributes.description: Collection of patient care plan records documenting goals and planned interventions.

attributes.name: Care Plans element
attributes.description: A single patient care plan record.

attributes.name: planNarrative
attributes.description: A human-readable summary of the care plan, including its goals, activities, and context.

attributes.name: planNarrativeStatus
attributes.description: The status of the narrative text associated with the care plan (e.g., generated, additional).

attributes.name: planStatus
attributes.description: The status of the care plan (e.g., draft, active, on-hold, revoked, completed).

attributes.name: planIntent
attributes.description: The intent of the care plan, indicating the level of authority and authorization (e.g., proposal, plan, order).

attributes.name: planCategory
attributes.description: The category or type of care plan (e.g., assess-plan, longitudinal).

attributes.name: effectiveDate
attributes.description: The date and time the care plan became or becomes effective.

dataClasses.name: Practitioners
dataClasses.description: A member of the care team

attributes.name: Practitioners data class
attributes.description: A member of the care team

attributes.name: Practitioners element
attributes.description: A single care team practitioner record associated with the patient.

attributes.name: practitionerName
attributes.description: The care team provider full name.

attributes.name: practitionerIdentifier
attributes.description: This is the care team provider identifier.  This would typically be the NPI.

attributes.name: practitionerRole
attributes.description: The clinical or administrative role of the care team practitioner.

attributes.name: practitionerStatus
attributes.description: The current status of the practitioner within the care team.

attributes.name: practitionerAddress
attributes.description: The practice or mailing address of the care team practitioner.

attributes.name: practitionerTelecom
attributes.description: The telephone or other telecom contact information for the care team practitioner.

attributes.name: Clinical Tests data class
attributes.description: A collection representing clinical test orders and results performed on a patient, including laboratory and diagnostic imaging tests.

attributes.name: Clinical Tests element
attributes.description: A single Clinical Test element of the Clinical Tests Data Class.

attributes.name: testStatus
attributes.description: The status of the clinical test (e.g., registered, preliminary, final, amended, cancelled).

attributes.name: testCategory
attributes.description: The category of the clinical test (e.g., laboratory, imaging, survey).

attributes.name: test
attributes.description: The concept representing the specific clinical test or observation that was performed.

attributes.name: effectiveDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the clinical test was performed or the specimen was collected.

attributes.name: testPeriodStart
attributes.description: The start date of the period over which the clinical test was performed or observed.

attributes.name: testPeriodEnd
attributes.description: The end date of the period over which the clinical test was performed or observed.

attributes.name: resultValue
attributes.description: The result value of the clinical test, which may be a quantity, coded value, or string.

attributes.name: resultUnit
attributes.description: The unit of measure associated with the clinical test result value.

attributes.name: testDataAbsentReason
attributes.description: The reason why a result value is absent or not available for the clinical test.

attributes.name: IssueDate
attributes.description: The date the clinical test order was issued or requested.

attributes.name: hasAttachment
attributes.description: Indicator representing whether the clinical test result includes a digital attachment such as an image or report.

attributes.name: performerName
attributes.description: The name of the person or organization that performed the clinical test.

attributes.name: performerIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the person or organization that performed the clinical test.

attributes.name: Coverage data class
attributes.description: A collection representing a patient's insurance coverage details as reported by the payer.

attributes.name: Coverage element
attributes.description: A single Coverage element of the Coverage Data Class.

attributes.name: coverageStatus
attributes.description: The status of the coverage record (e.g., active, cancelled, draft, entered-in-error).

attributes.name: coverageType
attributes.description: The type of insurance coverage (e.g., medical, dental, vision, pharmacy).

attributes.name: coveragePeriodStart
attributes.description: The date on which the coverage period begins or the policy became effective.

attributes.name: coveragePeriodEnd
attributes.description: The date on which the coverage period ends or the policy was terminated.

attributes.name: relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the covered member to the primary subscriber (e.g., self, spouse, child, other).

attributes.name: memberIdentifier
attributes.description: The identifier assigned to the covered member by the payer.

attributes.name: memberIdentifierType
attributes.description: The type of identifier used to uniquely identify the covered member (e.g., member ID, national identifier).

attributes.name: subscriberIdentifier
attributes.description: The identifier assigned by the payer to the primary subscriber of the insurance policy.

attributes.name: payorIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the payer or insurer responsible for the coverage.

attributes.name: planName
attributes.description: The name of the health plan benefit offering associated with the coverage.

attributes.name: planIdentifier
attributes.description: The identifier assigned to the specific health plan benefit offering.

attributes.name: groupName
attributes.description: The name of the employer group or plan sponsor associated with the coverage.

attributes.name: groupIdentifier
attributes.description: The identifier assigned to the employer group or plan sponsor associated with the coverage.

attributes.name: Provenance data class
attributes.description: Collection of data provenance records documenting the source and authorship of clinical data.

attributes.name: Provenance element
attributes.description: A single data provenance record documenting source and authorship of a clinical data record.

attributes.name: recordedDateTime
attributes.description: The date and time the provenance record was captured.

attributes.name: agentType
attributes.description: The type of agent responsible for the clinical data record, such as practitioner or system.

attributes.name: agentName
attributes.description: The name of the agent responsible for the clinical data record.

attributes.name: agentIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the agent responsible for the clinical data record.

attributes.name: agentOrganizationName
attributes.description: The name of the organization associated with the provenance agent.

attributes.name: agentOrganizationIdentifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the organization associated with the provenance agent.

attributes.name: authorType
attributes.description: The type of author that created or contributed to the clinical record.

attributes.name: transmitterType
attributes.description: The type of system or entity that transmitted the clinical data record.
